description:
## [2.8.1](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.8.0...v2.8.1) (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **player:** hide logos and limit CricFy to 7.4 ([9e2a949](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/9e2a9495f8f382336dedb19c7390bb2c2f7426c0))

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks local premium tools and cleans up VIP labels.

patches.name: Remove ads, proxy & restrictions
patches.description: Stops background bandwidth sharing, removes ads, and hides the player app logo on 7.4.

options.description: Hides the scrolling announcement/redirect marquee bar on Home and Player screens.
Skips optional and forced update prompts on Splash startup.
Blocks promotional push notifications and skips the notification permission prompt.
Allows running inside work profiles, app cloners, or alongside HTTP debugging tools.
Deletes unused proxy/ad libraries to save about 7.7 MB. Not needed for ad removal.

patches.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches.description: Removes ads, tracking, and forced updates, and keeps channels working after patching.

options.description: Disables PushService and Firebase Cloud Messaging, skips Android 13+ notification permission prompts, and removes notification permissions and receivers.
Skips forced update screens. With this on the app never updates itself — re-patch a newer stock version to update.
Bypasses root and sniffer-app lockouts. Only turn this on if the app refuses to run on your device.
Deletes unused libraries and tracking components to save space. Not needed for ad removal.
Closes the in-app web view so ads cannot open landing pages. Pages that legitimately use it, like score pages, will close too.

patches.name: Clean Me page
patches.description: Removes Status Saver, Legal, and Help from the Me page.

patches.name: Custom codec
patches.description: Bundles a custom codec so AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, and TrueHD audio play out of the box.

options.description: Select an MX Player Custom Codec v3.1.0 file — recommended: aio-v3.1.0_r1.zip (all CPU types), or neon64-3.1.0-build_1.zip (ARMv8 NEON), neon-3.1.0-build_1.zip (ARMv7 NEON), or a raw libffmpeg.mx.so* binary.

patches.name: Remove ads & bloat
patches.description: Removes ads and online extras like Live TV, Tube, Shorts, and Games for a clean local player.

patches.name: Remove bottom navigation bar
patches.description: Removes the bottom navigation bar and moves Me to the top-right corner.

patches.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches.description: Removes ads and tracking, and hides the player app logo.

options.description: Disables FCM push notifications and the notification permission prompt.
Skips forced update screens. With this on the app never updates itself — re-patch a newer stock version to update.
Bypasses the sniffer-app lockout. Only turn this on if the app refuses to run on your device.
Deletes unused libraries and tracking components to save space. Not needed for ad removal.

patches.name: Remove ads, popups & restrictions
patches.description: Removes ads and promo popups, and keeps channels working after patching.

patches.name: Remove ads, telemetry & restrictions
patches.description: Removes ads, promo popups, and tracking, and keeps channels working after patching.

options.description: Hides the scrolling promo announcement card on the Events and Player screens.
Disables PushService and Firebase Cloud Messaging, skips Android 13+ notification permission prompts, and removes notification permissions and receivers.
Skips forced and optional update lockouts on Splash startup and Player exit.
Bypasses root and sniffer-app lockouts. Only turn this on if the app refuses to run on your device.
Deletes unused libraries and tracking components to save space. Not needed for ad removal.

patches.name: AdBlocker turbo & userscript bundle
patches.description: Updates the built-in ad blocker automatically in seconds instead of minutes, and can add a shortlink bypass userscript.

options.description: Cloud downloads ready-made filters in seconds (recommended). Local Turbo builds them on your device, faster than stock. Stock leaves 1DM unchanged.
Installs and auto-updates a mobile shortlink bypass userscript. Keeps your on/off choice, and never returns if you delete it.

patches.name: Browser setup prompts only once
patches.description: Shows the one-time browser setup prompts only once, even if you close the browser early.

patches.name: Optimize cold start and battery
patches.description: Makes the app open faster, use less battery in the background, and stay in Recents when you press Back.

patches.name: Preset browser settings
patches.description: Sets Brave as the default search engine on fresh installs. You can change it anytime in 1DM.

options.description: Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Saved or imported choices are not overwritten.
Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Match uses the selected provider when 1DM supports it, otherwise None.
Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Brave and DuckDuckGo are not supported by 1DM for reverse image search.

patches.name: Remove ads and promotions
patches.description: Removes banner and popup ads, upgrade offers, and sponsored shortcuts.
